test_title: PYST 22: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 6 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The correct answer is: **Instanteneous** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The correct spelling should be "**Instantaneous**" • **Instantaneous **means occurring or done instantly. (घटित या तुरंत किया हुआ) Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**, which is incorrectly spelt. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Presumptuous **means showing little respect for others by doing things they have no right to do. (ऐसे काम करके दूसरों के लिए बहुत कम सम्मान दिखाते हैं जिन्हें करने का उन्हें कोई अधिकार नहीं है) • **Illegitimate **means not authorized by the law; or not in accordance with accepted standards or rules. (कानून द्वारा अधिकृत नहीं; स्वीकृत मानकों या नियमों के अनुसार नहीं) • **Lascivious **means feeling or revealing an overt sexual interest or desire. (एक स्पष्ट यौन रुचि या इच्छा को महसूस करना या प्रकट करना) 33:T8fc, The erroneous part of the sentence is: **The mother loving looked**
